message: Renovate reads .github/renovate.json5, which depcurfew cannot read (it reads only JSON and JSONC Renovate files), so it cannot tell whether Renovate waits as long as npm (3 days, min-release-age: 3 in .npmrc)
fix: Make sure minimumReleaseAge in .github/renovate.json5 is at least 3 days, or move the configuration to renovate.json, which depcurfew reads
